definitions.explanation: The level to which coffee beans or tea leaves have been roasted, which affects flavor, aroma, and color. Most commonly used in the context of coffee.

examples.japanese: {焙煎度|ばいせんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ほど⟦{苦味|にがみ}→苦味：14101_nigami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧。
examples.english: The higher the roast level, the more bitter the taste.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦{焙煎|ばいせん}→焙煎：16935_baisen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焙煎度|ばいせんど}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げている→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: These beans are finished at a medium roast level.

examples.japanese: お⟦{好|この}み→好み：02767_konomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焙煎度|ばいせんど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧、{浅煎|あさい}り⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{深煎|ふかい}り⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{選|えら}べます→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: You can choose from light roast to dark roast according to your preferred roast level.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{焙煎|ばいせん}→焙煎：16935_baisen⟧ (roasting) and ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (degree, level). Widely used in specialty coffee culture in Japan, where roast level is an important factor in choosing beans. Japan has a thriving specialty coffee scene, and many cafes and roasters indicate the {焙煎度|ばいせんど} on their packaging.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焙煎度|ばいせんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧: light roast
- {焙煎度|ばいせんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧: dark roast
- {焙煎度|ばいせんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change the roast level
- {焙煎度|ばいせんど}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧: by roast level

ROAST LEVELS:
Japanese coffee uses an eight-level scale: {浅煎|あさい}り (light), {中浅煎|ちゅうあさい}り (medium-light), {中煎|ちゅうい}り (medium), {中深煎|ちゅうふかい}り (medium-dark), {深煎|ふかい}り (dark), and several finer gradations.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{焙煎|ばいせん}→焙煎：16935_baisen⟧: roasting — the process itself, without reference to degree
- {煎|い}り⟦{具合|ぐあい}→具合：01391_guai⟧: roast condition — a more colloquial way of describing roast level
